course_name: 單元操作與輸送現象(三)
outline: This module draws on the concurrent course in Heat, Mass and Momentum Transfer, which gives the necessary foundations. The aim of this module is to deepen the students knowledge of the unit operations with a focus on distillation, absorption, adsorption and drying processes. This provides a foundation for the Chemical Engineering. The present lectures will extend the Momentum Transfer to Heat and Mass Transfer. We will explore efficient short cut methods and briefly introduce the principles behind.
schedule:
1-4 weeks: Heat transfer by conduction
5-6 weeks: Heat Flow in Fluids
7-8 weeks: Heat Transfer to Fluid
9 week: Midterm Exam
10-12 weeks: Radiation Heat Transfer
12-14 weeks: Heat Exchanger
15 week: Mass Transfer
16 week: Final Exam
17 week: Introduction to Populatino Balance Model
18 week: Discussion class
assessment:
Homework and Quizzes 30%
Midterm exam 40%
Final Exam 45%
